g.text: A0 DEVELOPMENT - NOT RELEASED FOR MANUFACTURE

g.desc: A0 DEVELOPMENT - NOT RELEASED FOR MANUFACTURE

g.text: T1: F.Cu + B.Cu are two 2-turn primary sections in series; In1.Cu + In4.Cu are two 2-turn secondary sections in parallel.

g.desc: T1: F.Cu + B.Cu are two 2-turn primary sections in series; In1.Cu + In4.Cu are two 2-turn secondary sections in parallel.

g.text: Six-layer PCB. In2.Cu carries the secondary inner-terminal return. T1 pin 5 is the internal primary series via, not an external lead.

g.desc: Six-layer PCB. In2.Cu carries the secondary inner-terminal return. T1 pin 5 is the internal primary series via, not an external lead.

g.text: Primary dot = VIN; secondary dot = GND_ISO. PGND and GND_ISO must remain galvanically separate.

g.desc: Primary dot = VIN; secondary dot = GND_ISO. PGND and GND_ISO must remain galvanically separate.

g.text: Prepared EELP32 N87 set: nominal 0.21 mm center-leg gap. Target AL about 747 nH; verify Lm about 12 uH after assembly.

g.desc: Prepared EELP32 N87 set: nominal 0.21 mm center-leg gap. Target AL about 747 nH; verify Lm about 12 uH after assembly.

g.text: JLCPCB must confirm procurement, gap preparation and core installation. Stock ungapped halves are NOT substitutes.

g.desc: JLCPCB must confirm procurement, gap preparation and core installation. Stock ungapped halves are NOT substitutes.

g.text: Functional low-voltage isolation only. Output trim, ringing, thermal performance and startup need prototype validation.

g.desc: Functional low-voltage isolation only. Output trim, ringing, thermal performance and startup need prototype validation.
